title: The AskAny WordPress plugin before 2.2.0 does not validate the extension or content of files attached to chat…
description: The AskAny WordPress plugin versions before 2.2.0 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not properly validate the extension or content of files attached to chat messages. It relies on the browser-supplied file type, allowing unauthenticated users to upload PHP files and potentially execute arbitrary code if visitor attachments are enabled.
